## About
British + European Car Repair is a local family owned business on Moore Street in San Diego. We bring our experience and knowledge of Land Rover, Jaguar, BMW and Mini Cooper to the neighborhood, building our reputation one happy customer at a time.
We work on everything from a Range Rover Sport or Freelander to a Defender or an early Jaguar. We're a fully computerized garage with factory specification diagnostic equipment, so your car gets diagnosed accurately and repaired correctly.
Customers know Steve and his team by name, and we're proud of a 4.7 rating from 36 Google reviews.

## Services
- Land Rover service and repair: From Range Rover Full Size and Sport to Freelander, Discovery, Range Rover Classic and Defender.
- Jaguar service and repair: From early E-Types to the XJS, XJ, XK and XF.
- Driveability diagnostics: Finding the real cause of a problem with factory specification diagnostic equipment.
- Preventative maintenance and repair: Scheduled service intervals, inspections, belts and hoses, and fluid flushes.
- Land Rover suspension conversion
- Brake work and maintenance
- Cooling system service: Radiators, water pumps and hoses.
- AC and heating services
- BG transmission service: Helps extend transmission life, eliminate transmission shudder and reduce overall maintenance costs.
- BG fuel injection service: Cleaning of fuel injectors, throttle body, plenum, air intake, and intake valves and ports.
- Prepurchase inspection: Buying a used Land Rover or Jaguar? Know exactly what you're buying before you sign.
- Land Rover and Jaguar parts: New and used parts in stock. Call us and we'll help you locate the part you need.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Land Rover, Jaguar, Mini Cooper and BMW.

Q: How often should my Land Rover be serviced?
A: The factory recommended service schedule for all Land Rover vehicles is every 7500 miles.

Q: Can you help me find a part?
A: Yes. We carry new and used Land Rover and Jaguar parts. Give us a call and we'll help you track down what you need.
